= deferred-code(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Deferred typography
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-03
:normal-value: pass:n[(C) (R) (TM)]
:replacement-value: pass:r[(C) ... don't word--word]
:escaped-value: pass:r[\(C) \(R) \(TM) \... word\--word]
:literal-value: pass:[(C) (R) (TM)]
:source-highlighter: syntect
:alias: {replacement-value}

== Name
deferred-code - deferred typography in code

== Synopsis
deferred-code

== Description

[subs="+attributes"]
----
P01 {normal-value}
----

[subs="+macros"]
----
P02 pass:r[(C) (R) (TM) ... don't word--word]
----

[literal,subs="+attributes"]
P03 {normal-value}

[source,text,subs="+attributes"]
----
P04 {replacement-value}
----

[subs="+attributes"]
----
P05 {escaped-value}
----

[subs="+replacements,+macros"]
----
P06 pass:r[\(C)] pass:[(R)]
----

[source,text,subs="+attributes,+replacements"]
----
P07 {escaped-value} {literal-value}
----

[subs="-replacements"]
P08 {replacement-value} and (C).

[subs="+macros,+replacements,+quotes"]
----
P09 *pass:r[\(C)]* *pass:[(R)]*
----

[subs="+attributes,+macros"]
----
P10 {normal-value}anchor:code-target[]https://example.org/code[Next]
----

[subs="+attributes"]
----
P11 {alias}
----

[subs="+attributes"]
----
P12 {literal-value}
----

[subs="+attributes"]
----
P13 {missing}
----

[subs="+macros"]
----
P14 pass:r[\*literal\* \... \(C)]
----

[subs="+attributes"]
----
P15 {normal-value} <1>
----
<1> Deferred replacements retain callout numbering.

[subs="-macros"]
P16 pass:r[(C)] and (C).
